title: "Styles"

## 📝 Note / Side Note
```html
<div style="background:#E6F2FF; border:2px solid #4A90E2; padding:12px; border-radius:6px;">
  <strong>📝 Side Note:</strong> 
    
    This is a friendly clarification or extra detail.
</div>
```

---

## ⚠️ Alert
```html
<div style="background:#FFF8E1; border:2px solid #FFC107; padding:12px; border-radius:6px;">
  <strong>⚠️ Alert:</strong> 
    
    Be careful — this highlights a pitfall or important caution.
</div>
```

---

```html
<div style="background:#F5F5F5; border:2px solid #9E9E9E; padding:12px; border-radius:6px;">

</div>
```
